_about: Pass/fail thresholds for stage 2, written 2026-11-28 before run.py was first executed. Each check compares one key of results/<id>.json 'measured' with max (value <= x), min (value >= x) or equals. Thresholds are not loosened to make a task pass; a changed threshold keeps its old value and the reason under 'changes'.

2.01.title: Rotate a single hip joint
2.01.basis: kp = 100 N m/rad without gravity compensation: hold error predicted g(q)/kp <= 0.0128 rad (g <= 1.28 N m from LegModel.gravity), friction band 0.2/kp = 0.002 rad

2.02.title: Move a joint between two angles
2.02.basis: knee range [-2.7227, -0.83776] rad from go2.xml; requests outside range minus a 0.05 rad margin are clamped by the command layer

2.03.title: Control joint velocity
2.03.basis: PI loop kv = 2, ki = 100; gravity ramp about 0.56 N m/s gives a steady error near 0.006 rad/s; 0.03 rad/s is 4 % of the 0.8 rad/s command

2.04.title: Apply a controlled joint torque
2.04.basis: model J q'' + b q' = tau - g(q) - f sign(q'), J and g(q) from LegModel, b = 2 N m s/rad, f = 0.2 N m from go2.xml

2.05.title: PD controller step response
2.05.basis: prediction: second-order response with J = M_ii (LegModel.inertia), c = kd + b, k = kp; 5 % settling band; friction band 0.2/kp = 0.002 rad

2.06.title: Change gains and compare tracking
2.06.basis: four gain sets on a 0.15 rad step and a 0.15 rad, 1 Hz sine; predicted overshoot 20.8 % at (150, 0) and below 1 % at (150, 2)

2.07.title: Foot position from joint angles (FK)
2.07.basis: 500 random in-limit configurations per leg; MuJoCo geom_xpos (foot sphere) and xpos (hip, thigh, calf bodies) as ground truth

2.08.title: Foot to a Cartesian position (IK)
2.08.basis: 27 grid targets per leg; friction 0.2 N m / kp 150 = 0.0013 rad per joint, about 1 mm at the foot

2.09.title: Raise and lower one foot
2.09.basis: 80 mm vertical stroke, 0.6 s per segment, minimum-jerk

2.10.title: Move the foot forward and backward
2.10.basis: 120 mm horizontal stroke, 0.5 s per segment, minimum-jerk

2.11.title: Foot along a triangle
2.11.basis: constant 0.3 m/s along the edges, so velocity jumps at the corners; corner error estimated v / omega_n = 0.3 / 60 = 5 mm

2.12.title: Foot along an arc
2.12.basis: radius 60 mm semicircle in 0.5 s (minimum-jerk angle), chord back in 0.5 s at constant speed

2.13.title: Reject an unreachable foot target
2.13.basis: five designed targets, one per reason (two for joint_limit); 200 FK-generated reachable targets

2.14.title: Coordinate two legs on a supported robot
2.14.basis: FL and RR run the 2.12 arc cycle in phase; 4 ms is two control periods

changes.reason: The old check fitted q = q0 + a t^2/2 over the first 10 ms and compared a with (tau - g - f)/J. That ignores the passive damping, whose time constant J/b = 16.8 ms is longer than the window, so the fit read 27.0 rad/s^2 against 39.3 predicted while the full trajectory matched the model to 6e-5 rad RMS. The new check identifies J by least squares from J (v_k+1 - v_k)/h = tau - g(q) - f - b v_k+1 over the first 30 ms (MuJoCo's Euler integrator treats joint damping implicitly, hence v_k+1). The threshold (10 %) is unchanged; the old measurement is still written as initial_accel_quadfit_rel_error.

Added after the first run, no threshold loosened. FL and RR are point-symmetric in the model, so in phase they produced identical foot heights (difference 2.8e-16 m) and the original checks could not fail. The added run pairs FL with RL, which are not dynamically identical for a forward-moving path, with RL commanded half a cycle (0.5 s) out of phase.
